dataList.content:
For two hundred years... they tortured you...
就这样两百年间一直……

My Father...
把父亲……

It is... not their Fault, Sancho.
不要……责怪他们，桑丘。

The sin is mine to bear. The sin of dreaming an impossible dream...
这一切都源于我曾怀抱的那个，庞大而不切实际的梦……

You won't ever understand our unimaginable suffering. Comfy in that oblivion, which took even your instincts as a Bloodfiend away...
连血魔的本能都忘却了的你，怎么能想象得到我们经受的折磨。

Our pain... of being deprived of blood... for two hundred years...
整整两百年间，连一滴血都喝不到……

Our pain of having to stab our own Father with thousands of stakes...
还不得不亲手……千万次地刺穿我们的父亲……

But then...
但就在那时……

... an answer to our prayers arrived.
无数次的祈祷终于有了回应。

From the heavens cascaded a light most warm.
从天空中降下了一道温暖的光芒。

Warmer than the light that was forever taken from us...
那是我们一生都未曾见过的光芒……

Gentler than my last memory of the sun as a human...
比我作为人类的最后记忆中的阳光还要更加明亮和温暖……

Sansón.
参孙。

Which Family is he from?
他是从哪个家族出身的血魔？

I don't know... Why should any of that matter? Family? Elders? All those meaningless concepts, washed away by two hundred years of pain!
不知道……家族、长老什么的，我在这两百年里全都忘光光啦！

What I do know, is that he saved us from this torturous hell.
但我知道的是，他把我们从这个无底深渊中拯救了出来。

That's... when La Manchaland opened once again!
从那时起……拉·曼却领就重新开张啦！

It pains me terribly to see you in such dire states, my Relatives.
真是令人心痛啊，我的亲戚们。
dataList.place:
La Manchaland, Past
过去，拉·曼却领

dataList.content:
You all look... absolutely terrible.
你们的样子实在是……惨不忍睹啊。

Light... so warm...
光……好温暖……

Throat... dry... thirst...
嗓子……好干……

Now wake up, everyone. We must prepare to greet our guests.
快些回过神来吧。必须赶快做好迎接客人的准备，对吧。

Gu...guests...?
客……人……？

Yes. Guests. Guests who will willingly supply their fresh blood for all of you.
是的，十分乐意为你们提供新鲜血液的客人们。

Blood... I yearn for... blood...
血……想……要……

So get a wardrobe change and freshen up. Let us start a festival louder, more flamboyant than before. Enough to captivate our new guests forever here.
所以，赶紧换上新衣服，打扮好吧。举办一场比以往更加喧闹、更加华丽的庆典，让那些踏进这里的客人永远无法回到家中吧。

Ah. The disgraced First Kindred. The Father of the Manchegan Bloodfiends, Don Quixote.
堕落的拉·曼却血魔们的亲族大人，一代眷属堂吉诃德。

Have you any idea how saddened the other Elders would be to see the state you are in?
若其他长老们看到你的模样，不知会多么痛心疾首啊……

... Such a warm glow...
……如此温暖……

What nature of... light... is this...?
这究竟……是什么……光芒……

It is the light of a Golden Bough.
它被称为金枝。

It will take root deep, deep within your heart...
它即将在你内心的最深处扎根……

... taking your desires, your subconscious as its nutrient...
并以你的欲望与潜意识为养分，不断生长……

I... hunger...
我……好饿……

The bough which your last Child will one day come to claim from you.
而终有一天，你最后的子嗣会再次将它拔起。

I... am now bound forever to this place, Sancho.
我注定要永远……被束缚于此，桑丘。

dataList.content:
For that is best for La Manchaland, best for my Family. My responsibility as their Father…
这是为了拉·曼却领和家人们的安宁，也是我作为父亲的责任……

There once was a time when you rather would choose death over causing harm to humans.
自很久以前起，您便比起死亡更加厌恶伤害人类了吧。

We... cannot defy our nature, Sancho. This is simply what we are.
我们……是无法违背本能的存在啊，桑丘。

Not even you, who left here to explore the world, an adventurer astride Rocinante...
就连骑着我送给你的驽骍难得，踏上了向外界的冒险之旅的你……

... was fated to return here now as a Bloodfiend...
最终也还是回到了作为血魔的命运之中……

Many... humans will loathe and abhor our very existence...
或许……许多人类会讨厌我们……憎恨我们吧……

But... my Children must feed on their blood... and find... true happiness...
但我的子嗣们……必须永远在这里……吸食更多的血液……必须获得幸福……

Here, at La Manchaland... where there is... only laughter...
在这充满欢笑的……拉·曼却领之中……

Thus, dear Sancho...
那么，桑丘……

Why not remain here with the rest of us...? Be with us who are cursed with the same sickness that ails you...?
你愿意和我们这些从诞生起就注定背负相同病症的人一起……留在这里吗……？

And you're happy with this sorry state you're in?
您对如今这般凄惨的状态感到满意吗？

Can't you see that... I am no longer the only one with claim to my body? It must be used... for the good of my Children who await salvation, protection amidst this terrifying world of misfortune...
难道你还看不出来吗……如今我的身体已不再只属于我自己。它必须奉献给我那在不幸中等待救赎与保护的子嗣们……

Father. The guests who accompanied Sancho here... are here to lay destruction upon La Manchaland.
父亲，那个人带来的访客……是为了破坏和摧毁我们的拉·曼却领而来的。

We will kill them... and feed you their blood.
我们会在杀掉他们之后……将他们的血献给您享用。

You remember well, don't you? Blood untainted by pathetic begging and struggling... The blood of those who so bravely seek to kill us... boils much, much hotter.
您也知道的，比起那些哀求活命的人类的血，那些拼命想杀死我们的人类流淌出的血液要炽热得多……

Indeed... my Children.
是啊……我的子嗣们啊。

You all speak true. Then please, kill them and lead La Manchaland once again into the festival of dreams...
就如你们所说。击败他们，然后将拉·曼却领再度引向梦幻般的庆典吧……
